# Americonfort

> Americonfort is a premium car rental service in Morocco. Customers browse the fleet, choose pickup location and dates, and reserve vehicles online.

The public website is a React single-page application. Staff and owner tools live under `/owner` and are not intended for general users or AI booking agents.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.americonfort.com/): Brand landing page with search (location + dates), featured vehicles, and company highlights
- [Cars](https://www.americonfort.com/cars): Full fleet listing with search and category filters; supports query params `pickupLocation`, `pickupDate`, `returnDate`, and `category`
- [Car details](https://www.americonfort.com/cars): Individual vehicle pages at `/car-details/:id` with specs, pricing preview, and reservation form
